name: tripalogue
description: TripAlogue: travelogue authoring and production as a web application. Phase 0 foundations: accounts, cloud project storage with an operation log and versions, resumable uploads, media processing, player, telemetry hooks.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --no-warnings --import tsx scripts/exit-test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --no-warnings --import tsx src/node/cli.ts serve --data data
scripts.test:phase1: npm run build && node --no-warnings --import tsx scripts/phase1-test.ts
scripts.test:phase2: npm run build && node --no-warnings --import tsx scripts/phase2-test.ts
